title: Attacker Persona
description: Reviews code from the attacker's perspective - 'how would I break this' - instead of the author's. The persona shift finds vulnerabilities that correctness-focused review walks past.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Taint Analysis
description: Tracks untrusted data from sources to sinks, flagging every path where user input reaches a dangerous operation unsanitized. Taint analysis finds injection flaws systematically, not by luck.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Secret Scanning
description: Scans code and history for committed secrets - API keys, tokens, private keys - with entropy and pattern detection. Scanning catches the credential that 'temporarily' entered the repo three years ago.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Dependency Vulnerability Checks
description: Checks every dependency against vulnerability databases, failing builds on known-exploitable versions. Most breaches ride in through dependencies; checking keeps the supply chain honest.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Prompt-Injection Review
description: Reviews AI-integrated code for prompt-injection paths - where untrusted content can steer the model. Injection review treats model inputs with the suspicion SQL inputs earned decades ago.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Race-Condition Hunting
description: Hunts time-of-check-to-time-of-use races and concurrency flaws where the interleaving matters more than the logic. Race hunting needs systematic interleaving analysis, not just reading.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Auth Bypass Checks
description: Verifies every sensitive path enforces authorization - not just authentication - hunting the missing check. Auth bypass is the most common critical web flaw, and it is always a missing line.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Input Validation Audits
description: Audits that every input is validated at the trust boundary - type, range, shape - before use. Validation audits find the endpoint someone forgot, which is always the one attackers find first.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Crypto Misuse Detection
description: Detects cryptographic mistakes - ECB mode, static IVs, homebrew ciphers, weak randomness - that silently void encryption. Crypto misuse is common because the code 'works' while being broken.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: SBOM Verification
description: Verifies the software bill of materials - every component, version, and origin - against what actually ships. SBOM verification proves the inventory is complete and honest.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Patch Verification
description: Verifies security patches actually fix the flaw - with exploit tests, not just code reading. Unverified patches are how 'fixed' vulnerabilities get exploited anyway.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: False-Positive Triage
description: Triages scanner findings quickly and accurately, tuning rules from each verdict so noise decreases over time. Good triage is what keeps teams listening to the scanner.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Severity Scoring
description: Scores findings by real risk - exploitability, exposure, data at stake - not just scanner defaults. Honest scoring focuses fixes where they prevent breaches.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Fix Suggestions
description: Suggests concrete fixes - the safe API, the correct check - not just problem descriptions. Suggestions turn findings into merged PRs instead of ignored tickets.
provenance: Public technical knowledge compiled from standard references and documentation; verified 2026-10-21.

title: Review Reports
description: Produces review reports that executives understand and engineers can act on - risk summary, findings, fixes, trends. Reports close the loop between review effort and security outcomes.
